title: Persistent Bluetooth pairing request with Bond BT Device on A15+ setting
body:
When enabling the _Preferences->Bond BT Device on A15+ (Pixel Phones Workaround)_ setting, I receive persistent  Bluetooth pairing requests on every Bluetooth attempt as shown below:

![Image](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/1b5a5f03-cf7b-4ec3-8d71-9165f1f43ea9)

If the feature is disabled then pairing request messages disappear but a workaround is unavailable in my experiments.

This happens on a Samsung Galaxy S23U ( model SM-S918U) with Omnipod Dash.

Particulars of build and NS version:

AAPS 3.3.2.0
Build: ba551caffc-2025.04.04
Remote: https://github.com/nightscout/AndroidAPS.git
Flavor: fullrelease
Nightscout version: 15.0.2

Logs attached as well.

[AndroidAPS_LOG_1750853249273.log.zip](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/20905916/AndroidAPS_LOG_1750853249273.log.zip)

comments.body: That's normal and expected. You need to accept the pairing request.
Got it, my understanding is that since it was LE Bluetooth that the pairing was actually not necessary,/required I'll go ahead a close this upon confirmation.
If you don't need to use the bonding option then you can disable the setting and then you won't get the pairing requests.

After pairing it to get rid of the persistent pairing message, the pump is unable to communicate with AAPS (it's been a out 30 mins since I paired it).  

I receive a _READSTATUS KeepAlive. Status outdated _ when performing a refresh with the setting ENABLED or disabled.  This is after restarting AAPS both with the setting enabled/disabled.

This pump is about to expire so I'm in dire straits, but the pairing is what caused the behavior.  I occasionally enable/disable the _Bond BT device_ setting (previously without accepting the pairing request) in order to try to troubleshoot and workaround bug #4047 

![Image](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/6226e783-aa20-4618-953d-6b780b9f8392)

I'm uploading logs to see if this helps, I'm going to discard this pump in the next hour unless there are any other steps anyone might need to replicate or troubleshoot.
This issue should be closed since "Persistent Bluetooth pairing request" is normal when using the Dash bond option in AAPS.
